title: Q5® Site-Directed Mutagenesis
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.besrjed6
materials: Assemble the following reagents in a thin-walled PCR tube. 25 μl RXN FINAL CONC. Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix 12.5 μl 1X 10 μM Forward Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM 10 μM Reverse Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM Template DNA (1–25 ng/μl) 1 μl 1-25 ng Nuclease-free water 9.0 μl E0552 Q5 PCR Mixture by New England Biolabs
Assemble the following reagents: E0552 KLD Mixure by New England Biolabs
Thaw a tube of NEB 5-alpha Competent E. coli cells on ice.
Spread 50-100 μl onto a selection plate.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Transfer the reaction to a thermocycler and run the following cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: 25 Cycles of: 98°C for 10 seconds, 50–72°C for 10–30 seconds, and 72°C for 20–30 seconds/kb

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Transformation
steps.instruction: Prepare the thawed cells by adding KLD mix and incubating.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 μl of KLD mix to the tube of thawed cells
Mix well by pipetting up and down
Carefully flick the tube 4-5 times to mix (do not vortex)
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes
Place the mixture on ice for 30 minutes

steps.title: Perform Heat Shock
steps.instruction: Execute the heat shock procedure to introduce DNA into the cells.

steps.title: Outgrowth and Incubation
steps.instruction: Recover the cells in SOC medium and incubate for growth.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 950 μl of room temperature SOC (New England Biolabs Catalog #B9020S) into the mixture
Incubate at 37°C for 60 minutes with shaking at 250 rpm
Mix the cells thoroughly by flicking the tube and inverting
